files.modifications: Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Injected-environment capture lifecycle: one capture at a time, permission gating without hiding islands, hide/restore exactly once on success, cancel and failure, error classification without image contents.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Propagate hover preference changes to existing display presenters immediately. M2 capture increment (0.2.0): capture shortcut lifecycle tied to start/stop and its setting; capture flow wiring, island hide/restore, peek after capture, Copy/Remove/Clear, thumbnails, status messages, and export cleanup at launch and every 30 minutes while running.

Adapted getClosedNotchSize measurement ideas into pure display inputs and screen-relative layout; added external floating capsule placement and size bounds. Test-driven fix: preserve menu-bar clearance by bounding panel height below its top edge; compress margins on synthetic tiny frames. Menu-bar clearance: place both complete window rectangles below the maximum safe-area, visible-frame and explicit menu-height band; bound compact/expanded bodies to usable space, and reject unusable geometry. Camera width is metadata, not a content spacer. Notch-sized placement (0.1.3): replaces the below-menu-band placement, which covered application content. On notched displays the compact window equals the public camera-housing rectangle at the top edge, which holds no menus or status items; implausible housing metadata falls back to a bounded width. Non-notched displays use a small pill inset inside the menu-bar center. Only the user-opened expanded state extends across the menu row; expanded content starts below the housing.

files.modifications: Adapted nonactivating panel configuration; replaced upstream managers with per-display presenter and shared local coordinator; removed capture/defaults registration and global services. Extracted original local presentation state into separately tested IslandPresentation.swift. Hover responsiveness: one stable native tracking host per panel, reconcile the actual cursor after events/show/resize, stop tracking before hide/close, and apply preference changes immediately. Refresh public screen/status-bar geometry on show/update/expansion and hide an unusable layout before activating native tracking; menu-row pixels contain no island window. Notch placement (0.1.3): panel level above status items so an open island draws over the menu row; explicit mouse-event receipt for the visually empty notch target; pointer reconciliation includes the display's top edge. Peek entry point for post-capture acknowledgement.

files.modifications: Extracted locally written presentation state from panel controller; injectable cancellable delay scheduler and stale-callback guard for deterministic race tests. Hover responsiveness: deduplicate unchanged pointer/preference inputs; use 80ms entry and 120ms exit waits; immediately cancel disabled hover work and reset hidden presenters. Peek state: opens briefly, held while the pointer is on it regardless of hover setting, closes after pointer exit, never disturbs an open shelf.

Written for this personal project; no upstream file copied. Native presenter owns hover events; SwiftUI content animation shortened to 120ms, respecting Reduce Motion. Move compact tray/Shelf/count content below the system menu band and remove camera-gap and extra notch-height content padding. Notch placement (0.1.3): compact notch state draws no visible content; non-notched compact state is a tray/count pill; expanded content is inset below the camera housing. Shelf tiles with thumbnails, time, Copy/Remove; Capture and Clear header buttons; status message line.
